$description: BookCraft AI design tokens (W3C DTCG format). Colour values per theme under color.dark / color.light.

bg.$description: App canvas behind the sidebar and workspace (zinc-950 / zinc-50).

surface.$description: Cards, sidebar, panels, table body (zinc-900 / white).

surface-raised.$description: Inputs, hovered rows, active nav item, code chips (zinc-800 / zinc-100).

surface-sunken.$description: Agent console and log wells; sits inside a surface.

border.$description: Hairline dividers and card outlines (zinc-800 / zinc-200). Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

border-strong.$description: Input and control outlines; 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

ink.$description: Primary text and headings on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, labels, table metadata on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken.

ink-subtle.$description: Placeholders, timestamps, word counts on surface and surface-sunken only (≥4.5:1 there).

accent.$description: Indigo-600 fill: primary buttons, active tab underline, selected node ring. Text on it is on-accent.

accent-hover.$description: Hover state of an accent fill.

accent-text.$description: Indigo text, links, icons, focus ring and active nav icon on bg, surface, surface-raised, accent-soft.

accent-soft.$description: Indigo tint behind accent-text: active nav item, selected chunk, accent badges.

success.$description: Emerald fill: Approve & Dispatch, live status dots, completed agent nodes. Text on it is on-success.

success-text.$description: Emerald text: ‘Active’, ‘AUDIT PASS’, high intent scores, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, success-soft.

success-soft.$description: Emerald tint behind success-text in badges and the verification report.

warning-text.$description: Amber text: pending checkpoint, medium intent, on surface, surface-sunken, warning-soft.

danger.$description: Rose fill for destructive confirmations. Text on it is on-accent (white).

danger-text.$description: Rose text: ‘AUDIT FAIL’, errors, Reject outline, on surface, surface-sunken, danger-soft. Always paired with an icon or word.

info-text.$description: Sky text for tool calls (call_tool) in the console, on surface-sunken and surface.

chart-1.$description: First data series (indigo). Validated with chart-2 for colour-blind separation in both themes.

chart-2.$description: Second data series (teal). Never reuse status colours for series.
